biggest_catch: The daily-login bonus is real but tiny — GrabPoints pays per completed survey, and survey availability varies wildly by country and profile, so most logins earn almost nothing.
catches: Points convert at 1,000 pts = $1.00 on the official homepage; daily-login/streak bonuses add only small amounts on top.
Survey disqualifications are frequent — minutes of unpaid qualifying questions are the norm, not the exception.
Earnings depend heavily on country (US/UK/CA/AU get the most surveys) and demographic profile.
Points expire after 12 months of inactivity (widely reported; confirm in account terms).

steps: Sign up free at grabpoints.com with email or a Google/Facebook account (no fee).
Complete your profile surveys so GrabPoints can match you to surveys.
Log in daily — daily streaks and check-in bonuses add small point bonuses.
Complete surveys (typically 5–15 minutes) to earn points per survey.
Cash out same day once you have enough points: redeem for PayPal cash, Visa, or gift cards (Amazon, Walmart, etc.) at 1,000 pts = $1.
timing: Points credit per completed survey; cash out same day to PayPal or gift cards (per official homepage).
